shorts_extract.hook: Why four simple letters in the wrong ink slow every literate adult by 74% — and what J. Ridley Stroop's forgotten third experiment proved about brain highways.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Stroop (1935): +5.6% reading words vs +74.3% naming ink (63.3 s to 110.3 s across 70 subjects), plus anterior cingulate conflict braking.
shorts_extract.twist: Debunking the 'simple speed race' myth via Stroop's 8-day Reverse-Stroop training and Cohen's pathway-strength model.
